scope: Exploratory. Filtered queries: complete bundles overlapping training are excluded, and test bundles overlapping validation. Splits were inspected earlier. Retail and Dunnhumby use one seed-0 resplit with few test queries.
estimator: L_gh=log((O_gh+1)/(E_gh+1)), O ordered distinct-item pairs across bundles, E=P(F_g F_h-delta_gh sum_i_in_g f_i^2)/(F^2-sum_i f_i^2), P=sum_b d_b(d_b-1). Residual e_i=x_i-n_g/(n_g+1) mu_g on the coarsest level.
menu: lift per group level, residual per modality, popularity, pair, incidence and amplified (power 2, top 100) history

decision.dataset: Passes if general beats raw and beats the shuffled mean on NDCG with Holm p<.05, and beats every shuffled seed.
decision.theory: General only if every dataset passes. Any failure is reported as a counterexample.
decision.cost: The gap to the current dataset-specific recipe is reported and does not decide the pass.

recipe_note: Current recipes are refitted separately on this source with their own settings on all validation queries, not under this partition.
